message: One messy spreadsheet and one plain-English prompt: Claude Code built the owner a dashboard and found £2,955 he's still owed

lines.text: One messy spreadsheet and one prompt, and Claude Code found this owner almost three thousand pounds.
Put the owner's spreadsheet in a folder, messy dates and all.
Open Claude Code and ask for the dashboard in plain English.
It cleans the data and writes one page that opens with a double click.
That's a tool an owner pays for every month. Comment DASHBOARD for the prompt.
